shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat frontal face
frontal standing or seated human-like figure with headdress
horizontal registers or bands dividing the surface
small repeated block-like ornamental motifs in the upper zone
circular / disc-like element on the torso area
justification: Both are tall frontal stone monuments whose flat face carries a centred anthropomorphic figure with an elaborate headgear above and horizontal banding, with small squarish repeated motifs clustered in the upper register — a genuinely comparable vertical compositional scheme. They differ sharply in execution: A is a massive, dark, heavily eroded block with broad, blunt, deeply weathered forms and a dominant plain disc, while B is a thin pale slab with crisp, dense, finely detailed shallow relief and clearly delimited rectangular panels.
